date_of_action: 2025-06-06 (Los Angeles operation begins; backstory) through 2026-11-06 (Ninth Circuit temporarily stays the race-based-stops injunction)

section_summaries.what_changed: A judge barred LA stops based on race, language, place or job; the Supreme Court let them resume; in 2026 she held DHS in contempt and again barred race-based stops.
